stories.headline: Trump waives new Russia sanctions days before they took effect; Zelenskyy urges allies to push back
stories.summary: President Trump signed an order late Friday pausing sweeping, congressionally passed sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to start, drawing bipartisan anger in Congress. Zelenskyy called the move unfortunate and urged supporters to press for reviving them as Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy grid continue.

stories.headline: Nasdaq slides 2% to cap worst week since June as AI trade cracks
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.09% to 7,659.44 and the Nasdaq dropped 2.14% Friday, both closing below their 50-day averages, while the VIX topped 22 for the first time in four months.

stories.headline: Northwestern stuns Michigan State 24-21 on last-second field goal
stories.summary: After MSU had a go-ahead 33-yard try blocked with a minute left, No. 25 Northwestern drove for a 34-yard winner with two seconds remaining; the Spartans fall to 2-5, 0-4 Big Ten, and visit UCLA Oct. 24.

stories.headline: Douglas County water plan could limit groundwater-dependent development
stories.summary: With demand projected to rise 45% by 2050, the county's 2050 water plan recommends heightened review or prohibition of new projects relying heavily on nonrenewable groundwater, a direct factor in where growth can happen.

stories.headline: Masked settlers attack European diplomats in the West Bank
stories.summary: Settlers armed with metal bars attacked Belgium's consul general and French and Polish diplomats near Taybeh on Saturday; Israel's military condemned it and police opened an investigation.

markets.summary: A rough week for growth: the Nasdaq fell 4.5% and the S&P 500 1.9% as the AI and chip trade sold off, while the Dow eked out a 0.7% gain on rotation into defensive and value names; both the S&P and Nasdaq closed Friday below their 50-day averages with the VIX above 22. Small caps lagged too, with the Russell 2000 down 3% for the week to 2,721 and now below its 40-week average. Rates stayed a headwind, with the 10-year Treasury yield near 5.1%, up roughly 22% this year. Gold futures held near $4,181, slightly lower on the week and below their 40-week average, while silver futures slid 5.6% to about $57.31 and are down 18% year to date. Momentum is soft across the board (RSI mostly 35-45, Nasdaq and S&P MACD below signal), but breadth near 45% is neutral, not washed out.

stories.headline: Evercore ISI says SpaceX shares should soon jump
stories.summary: Evercore ISI kept an Outperform rating and raised its target to $275 from $230, citing Starship reuse, Starlink deployments and AI-compute milestones as catalysts.

weather.summary: The East Coast story is a nor'easter off the Carolinas: it is tracking farther offshore, limiting inland rain, but persistent onshore winds will drive coastal flooding and beach erosion along the Mid-Atlantic into Tuesday. South Florida faces localized flash flooding Sunday from slow-moving storms on a stalled front. Monsoon-style moisture from Mexico keeps scattered showers and storms over the Southwest through Monday, and a Pacific low will raise rain chances along the West Coast. No significant snow or ice is expected in the Lower 48 through Tuesday, with temperatures easing back toward seasonal norms; mountain snow returns to the Sierra and Rockies later in the week.
